name: query-studio
description: SQL translator, analyzer and large-file workbench. Runs in the browser, on the desktop, and on mobile. No account, no upload, no server.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @query-studio/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace @query-studio/desktop
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npm run sync --workspace @query-studio/mobile
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:desktop:smoke
